There is a difference. Studio drummer Milt Holland Harlan from Chicago is quoted as saying when he was a young drummer how he realized how great a difference there was between black and white jazz styles. He found the black styles smoother and more musical; he wanted to know why some people played better than others. He discovered how some cultures are more rhythm and music based than others; that for some, these are inseparable from life. He even traveled to Africa, seeking the source. The controversy would…
